actions.description: Compound staging flow: create one FIN system/API account, save generated credentials locally, recharge and approve USDT through FIN, transfer spot to contract through frontend assets API, then place a contract Open API order.
actions.fallback: If FIN recharge succeeds but Open API balance remains zero, run frontend spot-to-contract transfer with the generated account password before placing the order. Never print generated API credentials.

actions.description: Create FIN Admin system/API accounts through /admin/fin/asset/system/account/add, poll add_progress, and retrieve generated account credentials plus API key, secret, and passphrase from temporary/list. Secrets are saved only to local ignored generated output when --save-secrets is present.
actions.fallback: If add_progress does not finish, inspect the visible FIN System Account Management page and query temporary/list by clientId; do not print generated credentials in chat.

actions.description: Compound workflow for requests to create STG frontend account(s), recharge spot through FIN Admin, then transfer the requested USDT amount to the contract account through the frontend asset-transfer API. Supports --concurrency for account-level parallel chains; each account remains register -> approve -> transfer in order. Frontend transfer responses 70008/20105 are retried by default without repeating registration or FIN recharge.
actions.fallback: If frontend transfer still fails after built-in retries and successful registration plus FIN spot recharge, report all created accounts, grant orders, transfer response codes, and stop without retrying duplicate account creation unless the user explicitly confirms a new batch.

actions.description: Batch create STG frontend accounts and recharge each through FIN Admin 空投奖励(产品化活动), using headless FIN auth reuse and visible login fallback only when the session is invalid.
actions.fallback: If headless FIN auth fails, the script opens the persistent FIN Chrome page for login and waits until the user closes it, then continues API-assisted execution.

actions.description: Create and optionally approve FIN Admin 空投奖励(产品化活动) grant orders through persistent Chrome CDP profile login state.
requiredParams: confirm-approve and runtime Google code for approval
actions.fallback: Use the visible FIN Admin page to observe requests. Do not perform real financial writes without explicit UID, amount, confirmation, and runtime Google code.
